subject: Weave: Aligning POC start timeslots + owners (Blue Harbor Logistics)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chan <alex.chan@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-14T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Weave: Aligning POC start timeslots + owners (Blue Harbor Logistics)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the run-through last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to lock in the POC kickoff window and confirm owners for each success area (integration, security gating, procurement signoff). Proposed plan below — please flag any conflicts: 

- Goal: 2-week POC to validate end-to-end latency and cost at 95th percentile workloads.
- Proposed kickoff: Week of Oct 27 (preferred) or fallback Nov 3.
- Stakeholders we need on the kickoff call: AE (marcus_lin), SE (soojin_lee), Blue Harbor infra lead (Alex Chan), Blue Harbor security (Priya Rao or security-team), Procurement (if contract/PO required).

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm availability for a 60-minute kickoff on either Oct 28 or Oct 29, 10:00–11:00 PT?
2) Can your security contact accept a short pre-kickoff questionnaire we send (it should take ~15 minutes)?
3) Any specific success criteria your team wants added to the POC doc before kickoff?

I've attached a draft POC success criteria doc and a compact network diagram for your infra team. If we get the go-ahead on dates, Soojin will propose a short tech preflight slot (30m) one business day before kickoff to validate access and sample data.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

Warmly,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0191

Attachments: POC-success-criteria-v1.pdf (summary), blueharbor-network-digest.png (diagram)

-----Original Message-----
From: Alex Chan <alex.chan@blueharbor.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@blueharbor.com>
Date: 2025-10-14T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weave: Aligning POC start timeslots + owners (Blue Harbor Logistics)

Thanks Marcus —

Oct 28 and Oct 29 both look possible at that time. Leaning toward Oct 29 because our infra lead will be traveling on the 27/28.

Quick items from our side:
- Priya (security) wants to review the questionnaire; she can loop in a network engineer if needed.
- Procurement is still finalizing PO thresholds — I can invite our purchasing lead to the kickoff as optional.
- Success criteria: in addition to latency/cost, can we add correctness on a ~100K record multi-tenant rewrite job and verify model isolation across tenants?

If Oct 29 works for you all, please send a calendar invite with the pre-kickoff tech verification as a separate 30-minute block the day before.

Alex
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Blue Harbor Logistics
alex.chan@blueharbor.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Alex Chan <alex.chan@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-14T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weave: Aligning POC start timeslots + owners (Blue Harbor Logistics)

Alex —

Oct 29 works for me. For the tech preflight I propose this agenda (30m):
- 5m: Introductions & objective alignment (marcus_lin + Alex)
- 10m: Network/access checklist (Dev) — firewall, IP allowlist, sample ingestion path
- 10m: Data sample confirmation & inference footprint (Soojinn) — sample shape, tokenization expectations
- 5m: Acceptance criteria review and next steps

Owners:
- Network/access: Dev Patel (dev.patel@redwood.ai) — will need Blue Harbor's egress/IP list.
- Test data & model configs: Soojin Lee — will prepare a ~100K multi-tenant test plan and expected outputs.
- Procurement at go/no-go: Lauren Bishop — will track PO/contract milestones and confirm payment terms.

Action items for Alex: share an egress IP list and a contact for procurement. I can draft the 100K test plan and circulate prior to preflight.

Thanks — soojin
Soojinn Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

-----Original Message-----
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@blueharbor.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Chan <alex.chan@blueharbor.com>, security-team@blueharbor.com
Date: 2025-10-15T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weave: Aligning POC start timeslots + owners (Blue Harbor Logistics)

Hi Marcus & team —

Thanks for the agenda. A couple notes from security's POV: 
- We'll need a completed questionnaire before the preflight; please send it as a doc we can redline.
- Network team prefers explicit CIDR ranges rather than single addresses for allowlist guidance.
- Data handling: we require that test payloads are anonymized and that logs do not include PII. Can you confirm Redwood's retention window for logs during a POC (and whether they can be disabled)?

I'll make time for the Oct 29 kickoff. I can also invite one additional security engineer for the preflight if needed.

Regards,
Priya Rao
Head of Security | Blue Harbor Logistics
priya.rao@blueharbor.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chan <alex.chan@blueharbor.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-17T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Oct 29 kickoff + Oct 28 preflight (Blue Harbor POC)

Alex/Priya —

Thanks for confirming. Final plan: 
- Preflight: Oct 28, 2025 10:00–10:30 PT — 30m tech verification (Dev Patel, Soojin Lee, Blue Harbor network/security).
- Kickoff: Oct 29, 2025 10:00–11:00 PT — 60m kickoff (All stakeholders).

Key POC success criteria (owners):
1) 95th percentile token latency under target SLA for representative load — Owner: Soojin Lee
2) Multi-tenant correctness on 100K rewrite job (isolation & output fidelity) — Owner: Soojin Lee
3) No unexpected exfiltration: logs PII-free and retention set to 7 days (configurable) — Owner: Dev Patel
4) Contract/PO signed or procurement path agreed by end of trial — Owner: Lauren Bishop

Next steps (action owners):
- Marcus: Send calendar invites + pre-kickoff questionnaire doc for Blue Harbor to redline.
- Dev: Share CIDR allowlist example and list Redwood egress ranges.
- Soojin: Draft 100K test plan and upload to the shared drive.
- Lauren: Prepare procurement checklist and draft temporary SOW language for PO submission.

I'll send an invite momentarily; please accept if the time works. Looking forward to a productive kickoff.

Best,
Marcus

Attachments referenced: POC-success-criteria-v1.pdf, blueharbor-network-digest.png
